research_mode: official Home Office accredited statistics; fail-closed limitations; no parcel score, candidate value or business result

sources.name: Release scope
verified_claims: The quarterly release covers use of police powers under terrorism and subsequent legislation in Great Britain up to the year ending 31 March 2026.
limitations: The release is a national or jurisdictional aggregate and cannot identify risk at an individual parcel.

sources.name: Other-legislation arrests
verified_claims: The release also covers arrests for terrorist-related activity made under other legislation, including the Police and Criminal Evidence Act.
limitations: An arrest category does not establish guilt or parcel-level conditions.

sources.name: Revision status
verified_claims: Administrative data are updated as cases progress through the criminal justice system, so figures may be revised in future releases.
limitations: Recent outcome counts are provisional and must not be treated as fixed parcel evidence.

sources.name: Data cutoff
verified_claims: Arrest and outcome data reflect the latest case position supplied by the Counter Terrorism Policing Headquarters Coordination Centre on 5 May 2026.
limitations: Later case developments may change charges, prosecutions and convictions.

sources.name: Total terrorism-related arrests
verified_claims: There were 3,061 arrests for terrorism-related activity in the year ending 31 March 2026.
limitations: This is a Great Britain total and not a neighbourhood incident count.

sources.name: Total arrests annual change
verified_claims: The 3,061 arrests represented a 1,186% increase compared with 238 in the previous year.
limitations: The increase is dominated by a specific legal and operational context and cannot be extrapolated to parcels.

sources.name: Palestine Action-linked arrests
verified_claims: There were 2,819 arrests linked to supporting Palestine Action after its proscription on 5 July 2025.
limitations: This aggregate must not be used to infer beliefs, conduct or risk for individuals or locations.

sources.name: Palestine Action-linked share
verified_claims: Palestine Action-linked arrests represented 92% of the 3,061 terrorism-related arrests.
limitations: The share reflects the release's classification and does not measure general local terrorism risk.

sources.name: Other terrorism-related arrests
verified_claims: After excluding Palestine Action-linked arrests, there were 242 terrorism-related arrests.
limitations: The residual category remains a national aggregate and is not parcel evidence.

sources.name: Other arrests annual change
verified_claims: The 242 other terrorism-related arrests were 1.7% higher than the previous year's 238.
limitations: Small national changes do not support exact-address scoring.

sources.name: Latest-quarter other arrests
verified_claims: Of the 242 other arrests, 44 occurred from January to March 2026.
limitations: Quarterly national counts cannot be spatially attributed to a parcel.

sources.name: Latest-quarter change
verified_claims: The 44 other arrests in January to March 2026 were 32% lower than the 65 in October to December 2025.
limitations: Quarter-to-quarter volatility does not establish a local trend.

sources.name: Total charges
verified_claims: At the data cutoff, 551 arrests, or 18%, had resulted in a charge.
limitations: The charge rate can increase as unresolved cases progress.

sources.name: Palestine Action-linked charges
verified_claims: The total charges included 484 arrests linked to supporting Palestine Action.
limitations: Charges are allegations and must not be treated as convictions or parcel risk.

sources.name: Arrests involving minors
verified_claims: There were 41 arrests of individuals aged 17 and under, including one linked to supporting Palestine Action.
limitations: Age-group statistics must not be used to profile individuals or places.

sources.name: Non-Palestine Action minors
verified_claims: Among non-Palestine Action arrests where age was known, 40 of 241, or 17%, involved individuals aged 17 and under.
limitations: The denominator excludes unknown ages and the statistic is not a local rate.

sources.name: Minors share change
verified_claims: The 17% share of minors among non-Palestine Action arrests was down from 19% in the year ending March 2025.
limitations: Year-to-year demographic shares are not parcel-level evidence.

sources.name: Persons tried
verified_claims: Seventy-two persons were tried for terrorism-related offences in the year ending 31 March 2026.
limitations: Trial counts are based on completed court cases and cannot be mapped to an address.

sources.name: Persons convicted
verified_claims: Of the 72 persons tried, 67 were convicted.
limitations: Conviction counts are England and Wales court aggregates, not parcel indicators.

sources.name: Conviction rate
verified_claims: The conviction rate among the 72 trials was 93%.
limitations: The rate is conditional on cases reaching trial and does not describe all arrests.
